title: Roti hai ab bhi
body:
roti hai ab bhi fatema zahra yahin kahin
teeron pe tha hussain ka laasha yahin kahin
<<DIVIDER>>
haan ye wohi jagah hai yehi wo zameen hai
tha khafela hussain ka utra yahin kahin
roti hai ab bhi...

qalbe hassan zameen pe bikhra yahin kahin
roti hai ab bhi...

jalta raha sagheer ka jhoola yahin kahin

bacchi giri thi khaake tamacha yahin kahin

akbar gira tha thaame kaleja yahin kahin
roti hai ab bhi...

tapta raha hussain ka laasha yahin kahin

roti hai ab bhi fatema zahra yahin kahin

bistar bana le khaak ko soja yahin kahin

<<DIVIDER>>
raahe safar mein ishq ke mil jayenge zaroor
zawwaron ke hujoom mein maula yahin kahin
roti hai ab bhi...
author: Naqvi
